newsitem.title: LATVIA: Unibanka still in spotlight on Latvian bourse.
newsitem.headline: Unibanka still in spotlight on Latvian bourse.

text.p: Latvia's Unibanka was in the spotlight again on Tuesday as its share price slid for the third straight session ahead of the July 28 auction of one million of the state's shares in the bank.
The bourse also announced on Tuesday after the morning price fix that the bank's half-year profit was 3.2 million lats compared to 3.6 million lats in the same period last year.
But dealers said the market was focused on the upcoming auction, which the privatisation agency said will go for no less than 3.05 lats per share.
"In the short-term, the six-month result will have no impact on the share price...it will come down to 3.05 lats and stay there for awhile," said one dealer.
"If it wasn't for this sale, which took a lot of people by surprise, it could have reached 3.50 lats and stayed there," the dealer added.
Its fall has brought the bourse index down. It slipped 1.74 points to 373.38.
But it has boosted volume on the sluggish bourse, which was a relatively active 100,000 lats on Tuesday.
Prices looked less bearish elsewhere on the official list, with three of its other five shares rising and two holding steady.
The Riga Transport Fleet extended its recent gains ahead of its interum results, which are expected to be promising. It rose to 1.23 lats from 1.21 lats in trade of 11,500 lats.
